scripts.assemble:pages: shx rm -rf .pages && shx mkdir -p .pages/A-homepage .pages/B-card-collection .pages/01-introduction && shx cp docs/index.html .pages/index.html && shx cp docs/styles.css .pages/styles.css && shx cp -r docs/A-homepage/* .pages/A-homepage/ && shx cp -r docs/B-card-collection/dist/* .pages/B-card-collection/ && shx cp -r docs/01-introduction/dist/* .pages/01-introduction/
scripts.build: npm run build:01 && npm run build:b && npm run assemble:pages
scripts.prepare:preview: npm run build && shx rm -rf .preview && shx mkdir -p .preview/react-d3-course && shx cp -r .pages/* .preview/react-d3-course/
scripts.deploy: npm run build:01 && npm run build:b && npm run assemble:pages && gh-pages -d .pages
